title: Project settings can disable user request budget
observed: Project .claude/settings.json overrides inherited user maxUSD/maxCalls with zero and can add freeModels exemptions before folder trust.
expected: Project and local settings may tighten inherited request ceilings and remove free-model exemptions; only user or explicit CLI settings may relax them.

fix.note: Untrusted project budget overrides are monotone; explicit user/CLI overrides remain available.
